risk_note: RV2 (app.module, growth). FU-INVITE-REWARD-WIRING, launch gaps 1 + 10 (D10-805 ①). The worker's invite reward payout now gets ledger's createInviteRewardGrantWriter (B2-16b had only built the writer), so qualified rewards post real REWARD vouchers instead of being deferred with invite_reward_writer_unavailable; the amount is the per-party value locked on the qualification row, replays return the stored voucher through the (app_id, uniq_key) uniqueness, and a missing voucher id rolls the payout back. The deletion port moves from users.status to identity's createDeletionStageReader, and cooling joins processing / done as deleting for that party only (08 BR-INV-24 ③); app isolation comes from the stage reader's app_id filter. grantWriter stays optional, so the frozen [AC-B1-35#61] is unchanged. Two stale TODOs removed. No migration, no contract. Integration spec/growth 469/469 pass.
